About Mr. Venki’s wardrobe

The original 11-foot-wide, 10-foot-high wardrobe and dressing arrangement is retained from your matching SketchUp files. The colour markings identify units; the finished model uses handleless beige-matte shutters and matte walnut wood-grain on the marked exposed areas.

The loft is shuttering only. The single-shutter and green-pair sections have top storage, hanging space, two drawers and three shoe tiers. The orange-pair section has shelves, one drawer and bedding storage. All three wardrobe sections include concealed LED strips. The fixed mirror has touch lighting; the beige makeup drawer pulls out, with PVC wooden louvers below and four walnut open compartments beside the mirror.

Internal fittings and contents illustrate the arrangements you selected. Exact shelf spacing is subject to final site measurements. Finish choices save on this browser. Quotation amounts have not been added.
